title: Data Engineer
text:
About Granite Cloud
Granite Cloud offers managed Postgres for teams that do not want a DBA. We are a small, remote-first engineering team that ships every day and keeps on-call quiet.
The role
As a Data Engineer you will own services end to end: design reviews, the code, the dashboards and the pager. You will work closely with product and with the other engineers on the team.
What you will need
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with Kubernetes
- 4+ years of hands-on experience with Helm
- 5+ years of hands-on experience with Spark
- 2+ years of hands-on experience with Python
- several years of hands-on experience with Rust
- 3+ years of hands-on experience with React
- Clear written communication; we decide things in documents
Nice to have
- Exposure to GCP
- Exposure to PostgreSQL
Benefits
Competitive salary and equity, a learning budget, and four weeks of vacation that people actually take.
